gist: A wife is the quiet strength of a home, the keeper of its hearth, and the unseen architect of a shared life.
book_long_title: Wife: The Keeper of the Hearth, the Quiet Strength of a Life
book_summary: A wife is not a role but a life — a woman who, in the quiet of a shared home, becomes the keeper of its hearth, the memory of its days, and the unseen strength that holds a family together through joy and grief, through plenty and want. This epic tells the story of that life: a woman who marries, who builds a home, who raises children, who weathers the storms of a long marriage, and who, in the end, discovers that the love she gave away was never lost — that it returned to her, multiplied, in the faces of those she held. It is the story of the quiet strength of a wife, and of the love that is the true architecture of every home.
era: Contemporary — the inner life of a marriage
